quote: STAMFORD | AvK (Cummins Generator Technologies) (China) Co., Ltd. was founded in 1996 in Wuxi City, Jiangsu Province, with a total investment of more than $40 million USD. We are the only authorised company that manufactures and sells STAMFORD and AvK brand alternators in China.
Two world-class production facilities in Wuxi, Jiangsu Province
